## F — Passing and following distance
Research index: 27 original C facts and 23 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Passing and following distance.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-PASSING-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-PASSING-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-PASSING-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-PASSING-DYNAMIC — Installed passing controls and present traffic/weather conditions govern the maneuver; no local posted speed or actual safe opening is invented.
VERIFY: ID-PASSING-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-PASSING-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-PARKING-BRAKE-PARENTHESIS — The parking paragraph on physical page eighty attaches an only-if-left-running parenthesis to setting the parking brake. The modifier's intended application is unclear and is not converted into advice to omit a parking brake when the engine is off; issuer clarification is required.
